title: The Hot Five, Skid-Dat-De-Dat and early scatting
summary: Gleason notes the Hot Five records were made in a short period; Armstrong says he named the group for recording, made up tunes in the studio, and scatting came from New Orleans quartets.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
